title: The Wedding Gift From the Village

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE IV: ROMANCE, COURTSHIP AND WEDDINGS (LCD-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Crushes and courting on Isola: wondering whether someone likes you back, flowers and love songs, first dates, serenades gone wrong, proposals, weddings big and small, how many children, breakups and starting over.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: The village wants to give a couple a wedding gift: build them a canoe, or plant them a garden.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) is organizing the village's wedding gift for (friend) and (friend.his/her) new partner. Some people want to build the couple a canoe. Others want to plant them a garden behind their new hut. There is only enough time and wood for one. What should the gift be?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: The village builds a small canoe and paints the couple's names on the bow. On the wedding morning, they find it on the beach with a garland on it. (friend) cries. The couple takes it out that afternoon and nearly tips it over twice.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: The village plants a garden behind the couple's hut overnight: taro, beans, flowers, a young breadfruit tree. In the morning, (friend) opens the door and stands there with (friend.his/her) mouth open. The garden feeds them for years.
